name: Make Me Lover
source:
The studio that brought you Custom Maid 3D presents a new design-your-own-girl game with a fun real-time strategy element! First, build your ideal heroine by choosing from three body sizes and a huge variety of expressions, hairstyles, and accessories. Then, build a fortress town and defend it from enemies as you explore deep dungeons in the real-time strategy mode. The buildings you place unlock new events and H-scenes! This game also features a "dark route," where you can unleash your dark fantasies and make your own harem. A must-have for fans of customizable girl games!

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PCG0089]J-List[/url]]
